summary: Frontend-only restyle regression at 390x844, plus ERP at 1280x900. All requested flows pass with no page errors, and no screen overflows horizontally (scrollWidth equals the viewport). WEBSITE: brand-name 'PRAJETA' is red rgb(229,57,53). hero-headline reads 'Chauffeurs for Your Own Vehicle' with the local hero-chauffeur.jpg. quick-booking-form, 9 service-card-* (the first is red-tinted), spotlight-card with a portrait, and footer-brand are present. CUSTOMER: red BrandLogo with 'DRIVER SERVICES'; the customer-greeting pill shows Mumbai and opens /customer/profile; topbar-sos-button opens the in-progress booking; notifications-button opens /notifications. The home-service-* grid has 8 items; a tap selects (2px red border) and does not navigate. home-rate-card opens /service/hourly. home-gear, home-pickup-input, home-when-select (home-date-sheet) and home-time-select (home-time-sheet) all work. book-now-button opens /book/hourly?city=mumbai&date=..&time=14:00&trans=Automatic&pickup=.. and the wizard prefills book-pickup-input and transmission. Monthly shows 'Request a Quote' and opens /book/monthly. quick-rebook-card, home-trust-strip, upcoming-booking-* (opens /booking/{id}), home-enquiry-monthly and home-whatsapp-button work. DRIVER: driver-name, DRV-BD14 and the VERIFIED badge are present. driver-online-toggle is a dark pill (rgb 23,23,23) and switches ON DUTY -> OFF DUTY -> ON DUTY. shift-telemetry-card and driver-today-earnings are present; instant-payout-link opens /driver/earnings. The dark offer card offer-PRJ-5RZW6N2L has offer-payout (₹538), the cockpit.jpg image, a red ACCEPT DUTY button and a decline button. Accept opens /trip/{id}. active-job opens /trip/{id}. compliance-card is present, and dispatch-central-card contains topbar-sos-button. ERP: 'PRAJETA ERP' is red. emergency-dispatch-button opens /erp/sos; admin-manual-booking and open-global-dispatch open /admin/bookings. The 4 KPI tiles are present; dash-dispatch-link switches to the Unassigned tab. queue-tab-0..3 filter the rows (8/8/3/5). exception-{ref} and quick-assign-{ref} open /erp/booking/{id}. kyc-queue-card, action-plan-card and dash-owner-link (opens /erp/owner) work. At 1280 the two-column layout works (exception-board x=16 w=759 | kyc-queue-card x=791 w=473). REGRESSION: wizard submit (after the terms checkbox) opens /booking/{id}. Customer booking detail shows trip-otp-card (OTP 7015). On the driver trip screen: arrive, type the OTP into trip-otp-input (a hidden INPUT), and trip-start-button starts the trip (trip-complete-button appears). Problems found: tapping the action-dispatch / action-drivers testIDs did nothing (the testID sat on the card container; fixed by adding -cta testIDs to the inner buttons); a future date defaults to 12:00 AM; text is truncated on the upcoming-trip rows and the driver header.

ui_bugs.component: Customer home booking card: default reporting time
ui_bugs.issue: If the user picks any future date (Tomorrow or later) but no time, home-time-select defaults to 12:00 AM. The slots for future days start at 00:00 and effTime falls back to slots[0]. Booking with this default creates a midnight booking with a ₹200 night surcharge (seen in PRJ-LT97KQ99: '2 Nov 2026 12:00 AM', night surcharge ₹200). Reference: /app/frontend/app/customer/index.tsx:49-50. Suggest keeping a sensible default such as 10:00 (or the previously chosen time) when dayIdx>0.

testID action-dispatch / action-drivers was on the ActionCard container View, not on the button, so tapping that testID did nothing. The buttons themselves worked. I added testID `${testID}-cta` to the inner Btn, and action-dispatch-cta -> /admin/bookings and action-drivers-cta -> /admin/drivers were verified. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/index.tsx:357

issues: StatusBadge (e.g. 'CONFIRMED · ASSIGNING', 'ADVANCE PENDING') is wide and top-aligned in the row. It squeezes the text column, so the title is cut off ('Hourly Dri...') and the ref/date too ('#PRJ-D9Q8...', '#PRJ-LT97KQ99 · ...'). Consider putting the badge under the title, or making it shrink and wrap. customer/index.tsx:219-231
The 'Rebook' button's right edge (~363px) runs past the card's inner padding (357px) at 390 width, so it looks cramped.

At 390 width the driver-name is always truncated ('Ravi Kumar (...'). With the OFF DUTY state the badge is also cut to 'VERIF...', because the dark ON/OFF DUTY pill plus the bell take most of the row. driver/index.tsx:88-99

If ?date= falls outside the 14-day chip list, 'Scheduled start' shows the raw ISO date ('2026-11-30, 11:00 AM') and no date chip is selected. Home only passes dates within 14 days, so this is minor. Also, the chosen time chip (e.g. 2:00 PM) is not scrolled into view in the horizontal time row.

The seed offer 'Demo address' dated 27 Oct 2026 (a past date, the day before the browser date of 28 Oct) still shows as 'NEW DUTY OFFER · 28 MIN LEFT'. This is seed data, but past-date offers should be hidden or expired.

action_items: Customer home: when a future date is picked, don't default the reporting time to 12:00 AM (customer/index.tsx:49-50). Default to 10:00 or keep the previously chosen time.
Customer home upcoming-booking rows: stop the StatusBadge from squeezing the title/ref (move it under the title, or let it wrap).
Driver header: make room for driver-name and the verified badge at 390 width (e.g. a smaller pill, or the name on its own line).
Optional: hide past-date driver offers; in the wizard, format an out-of-range date and scroll the selected time chip into view.
critical_code_review_comments: ActionCard put the testID on the container instead of the actionable Btn. Fixed by adding `${testID}-cta` to the Btn.
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) were found. The Expo web log only has expo-notifications push-token warnings, which are expected on web.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; 1 medium UX bug and minor truncation)

seed_data_creation: Ran setup_ui_iter12.py: a TEST_Toyota Fortuner vehicle (MH02UI5971) and booking PRJ-5RZW6N2L (85be7160...), offered to and accepted by the demo driver, then trip started (now IN_PROGRESS). The wizard created PRJ-LT97KQ99 (315ba824..., ADVANCE PENDING, 2 Nov 2026 00:00).
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP send is rate limited. Run `python /app/backend/tests/clear_otp_iter14.py` before each UI login. Sheets use animationType=slide, so wait about 1s after opening home-date-sheet or home-time-sheet before tapping options. The wizard requires book-terms-checkbox before book-submit-button. trip-otp-input is a hidden INPUT; .fill('7015') works. The browser clock is around 28 Oct 2026.
